1: Before anything was created, God was already there. Everything that was made began with God.
2: The world was not formed yet. Darkness was over it, and water covered everything. God was present.
3: God spoke, and light appeared. What God says happens.
4: God saw that the light was good. He separated it from the darkness so each had its own place.
5: By naming the light Day and the darkness Night, God gave each one its place. This is how the first day was set apart.
6: God made a wide space so the waters would not stay together. This space separated the waters above from the waters below.
7: God finished making the space between the waters. This space is the sky above the earth, not outer space.
8: God gave a name to the space He made and called it Sky. This is the space above the earth where clouds move.
9: God brought the waters together so dry land could be seen. This is when the land first appeared.
10: God gave names to the land and the seas. He saw that what He made was good.
11: God caused the earth to grow living plants. Each plant was made to reproduce in the way God designed.
12: The earth grew what God commanded it to grow. Each plant and tree grew as it was made to.
